class.name: IfcFlowMovingDevice
class.brief_description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowMovingDevice defines the occurrence of an apparatus used to distribute, circulate or perform conveyance of fluids, including liquids and gases (such as a pump or fan), and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcFlowMovingDeviceType or its subtypes. HISTORY: New entity in IFC R2x. IFC 2x4 NOTE: This entity has been deprec
